notes: The competing reading heads תַּחְבֻּלוֹת on *wise*; *guidance* carries the lexeme of the noun of steering and *wise* is the ASV's specifier, so rule 31's subtraction keeps the head on *guidance*.

אֵין takes the negation and the copula and heads on *no* under rule 50, discontinuous around the noun phrase; the second colon's בְּ is the prepositional predicate and takes the copula with its presentative dummy under rules 49 and 20.
